state.task: Advise on a product priority decision for CHOOGuard. This is model advice requested by the user, not a human approval, safety certification, or empirical product result.

current_user_decisions.other_actors: AI colleagues and individual citizens sharing the same explicit simulated world
not_selected: realtime generated video as the core world
current_user_decisions.tutorial: Separate from the main game. Switch between railway work roles and directly manipulate detailed parts, tools, cleaning objects and equipment.
current_user_decisions.main_game: AI colleagues and citizens have ordinary activity. Emergencies involving these actors and their world can be terrorism, accidents or natural disasters, and the human player responds. Tutorial mistakes do not automatically carry over into main-game incidents.
current_user_decisions.model_preference: Use Jev for AI colleague and citizen decisions, subject to a precise feasibility evaluation.
current_user_decisions.priority_request: The user delegated the accuracy-versus-gameplay question to Jev rather than choosing directly.

verified_research_facts.source_coverage: Public KORAIL common maintenance rules, government technical standards and public training materials were found. Not all current vehicle-specific work cards, torque limits, local approvals or internal employee SOPs are available.
verified_research_facts.separate_responsibilities: Jev offers typed decisions over supplied text. Game code must retain physical state, permissions, resource reservations and completion evidence. A model assertion is not a performed action.
verified_research_facts.existing_simulation_limit: The inspected smoke/crowd integration uses a bounded reference geometry and precomputed fire-field interval, not a validated arbitrary Busan-station disaster solver.
verified_research_facts.research_only: No gameplay code, scenes or assets are being changed in this task.

common_constraints_for_all_options: Do not present invented or game-authored values as official railway procedure or measured reality.
Do not silently change the user's separate-tutorial/main-game requirement or single-human requirement.
Keep hazardous-action authorization and task completion separate from model confidence.

accuracy_vs_gameplay.instructions: Which priority policy best fits the current user decisions and verified constraints? Compare the four alternatives as product policies. Select one; do not infer that the model has implementation or safety approval authority.

criteria.accuracy_first_everywhere: Prioritize documentary and simulation fidelity across training, daily NPC behavior and emergencies. Favor faithful pacing and detailed work even if less entertaining or less immediately responsive; retain honest uncertainty where evidence is absent.
criteria.gameplay_first_everywhere: Prioritize responsive, legible and entertaining gameplay across training and emergencies. Clearly label simplifications and authored simulation rules while respecting the common constraints.
criteria.shared_truth_flexible_presentation: Use one consistent rule and state model for roles, work prerequisites and completion; preserve documented safety-critical constraints. Adjust feedback, pacing, daily social behavior and presentation for playability without changing what counts as actually performed or known.
criteria.separate_strict_game_modes: Create distinct strict-training/research and entertainment rule profiles sharing assets and controls. Explain the differences, at the cost of maintaining and comparing two sets of behavior and completion rules.
